observations: Three photos show a large indoor space filled with numerous car engines and gearboxes stacked closely together.
The engines and gearboxes appear used, with visible dirt, grime, and signs of wear.
Some units have visible markings or tags, but none are clearly readable in the photos.
The environment is a dimly lit, unfinished room with concrete walls and floor, suggesting a storage or workshop area.
The watermark 'NZ JAPANESE AUTOS' is present on all photos, indicating the seller's branding.
No specific car models or brands are legible on any of the units.
The items are piled without organization, making individual inspection impossible from the photos.
